name: Counter-Strike 2 / HLTV
description: English to Simplified Chinese terminology for HLTV navigation, news, events, matches, and team pages, including Counter-Strike 2 statistics, tactics, weapons, maps, roster news, and Fantasy. Grouped by topic, with original-name entries for the top 100 teams, players qualifying under a specified Top 50 opponent filter, historical annual Top 20 players, and page samples.
author: Changyu Li

zh-CN.name: CS2 / HLTV
zh-CN.description: 面向 HLTV 主页、新闻、赛事、比赛及队伍页的 CS2 英译简术语库，按选手、队伍、赛事、组织、枪械等主题分组，涵盖界面、数据、战术、转会及 Fantasy，并保留前100队伍、指定Top50对手筛选选手、历年Top20和页面样本姓名原文。
